newsitem.title: FRANCE: Meyssonnier halts Foncier union dialogue.
newsitem.headline: Meyssonnier halts Foncier union dialogue.

text.p: Credit Foncier chairman Jerome Meyssonnier, held at the group's headquarters since Friday by staff protesting government plans to wind the home loans group down, will no longer negotiate with unions, French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday.
"He told me this morning that he could not keep up the dialogue as long as he was still denied freedom of movement," Arthuis told Europe 1 radio.
Arthuis reiterated that the government wanted to find a solution to the problems of Credit Foncier but that it did not want to inject money into the group.
"The state does not want to become shareholder of another state bank," he said.

Staff have been occupying the Paris headquarters of Credit Foncier since Friday to protest against plans to wind the group down and demand that the government give a stay of execution to find another solution.
